TestCDCBatchesSimple::test_delta_batch_o.relevance: CDC preimage modes on/full/off and postimage are live: cdc/log.cc:425-460 (options parsing, values lowercased), cdc/cdc_options.hh image_mode. Logged multi-partition batches (5 pk x 3 ck x 10 cols) of INSERT/UPDATE incl. null updates. Runs in next gating (both tablets and consistent-topology stages), 100% pass, ~5-13s per param x 11 types.

duplicates.note: [delta-all_types] scylla c454b23eb1 (merged 42ab0bf5bd), translated from this dtest: same 6 LOGGED batches (insert all, update all/even/odd, null, update all) over 5 pk x 3 ck, one table with all dtest types except varchar (alias of text), 4 cols per type; asserts the whole CDC log (every row, all columns, order, operation, one stream + contiguous batch_seq_no per group), incl. the last delta row the dtest skips. Atomic-types-only table (non-split INSERT path) only in the preimage+postimage params.
test_batch_images: unlogged batches, single partition per batch, int+map columns, preimage on/off + postimage; no 'full' preimage, no logged multi-partition batch, no type matrix.
same image modes x types, but single statements, not batches.

TestCDCBatchesSimple::test_delta_batch_o.reason: Fully covered by test/cqlpy/test_cdc_dtest.py::test_cdc_batch[delta-all_types] (scylla c454b23eb1), which asserts the whole delta-only CDC log of the same batch sequence over the same types in one table instead of 11 clusters. Bug: verify_cdc_rows sets delta_rows_end = len(rows) - 1 when postimage is off (cdc_batch_test.py:552), so the last delta row of every CDC group (per partition) is never verified; cqlpy checks every delta row.

issues.text: verify_cdc_rows: delta_rows_end = len(rows)-1 without postimage, so the last delta row of every CDC group is never verified
